## Definition of Done

<!-- Run `just check-template` and paste the output (or confirm it's green). See CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

- [ ] No new or changed dependencies in `Cargo.toml` / `Cargo.lock` (or maintainer approval is linked).
- [ ] UI changes: `just shot` images in light and dark attached, if applicable.
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or setup changed (`README.md` / `docs/`).
